description: Served fish and eggs at sixpence each, and stopped with the jug while he read.
name: Agnes Tipping

description: Raye reported disguises, Welsh jokes, and a house of two thousand.
name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

description: Refused a Rose sum and pointed him at the Jackdaw.
name: John Heminges

description: Took the long speech, read it to the fire, and asked who plays the other man.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Brought the four sheets, refused a name, and ate the eggs cold.
name: William Shakespeare
